description:
Create, list, show and delete person files. A person is a link target for note attendees and task assignees, never a thread.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list people; open ones only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CATEGORY — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Args:
  QUERY  optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity
  PERSON  full name, the same as the filename without .md

Flags:
  list: --all includes closed people. --json gives JSON output.
  show: --json gives JSON output.
  new: --name is required; it is the full name and becomes the filename. It must not contain '/' or start with '.'. --category is required: professional, personal or voluntary.
  delete: -y (or --yes) is required.

Examples:
  ["list", "charlie", "--json"]
  ["show", "Charlie Smith"]
  ["new", "--name", "Charlie Smith", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  Create the person before using them as a task assignee (tasks set-assignee, or '(Name)' in ACTION text).
  delete is permanent.
  Exit 1: empty or invalid name, person already exists, person not found, delete without -y.
